stance.label: Hyperliquid risk under review
stance.summary: HYPE fell 8.4% in 24 hours while Hyperliquid addressed an oracle anomaly tied to $57 million of equity-perpetual liquidations. DeBank verifies $404 on the venue.

market.oneLine: The relevant event is not a generic market lesson: it is a sharp HYPE move plus a fresh oracle incident at a venue holding ARC capital.

insights.headline: HYPE drops 8.4% as Hyperliquid explains a $57M oracle event
insights.summary: HYPE traded at $54.46 after an 8.4% 24-hour decline. Hyperliquid said an oracle anomaly triggered roughly $57 million of SK Hynix perpetual liquidations.
insights.portfolioRelevance: DeBank verifies $404 on Hyperliquid, about 0.7% of the $60,635 portfolio. This is venue exposure; DeBank does not show ARC holding HYPE.

insights.headline: ETH falls 3.4% against at least $10.7K of verified ETH-linked exposure
insights.summary: ETH traded near $1,878 after a 3.4% 24-hour decline. DeBank shows at least $10,694 of cbETH, ETH, WETH, and supplied WETH before counting LP components.
insights.portfolioRelevance: A parallel 3.4% move represents roughly $364 of gross sensitivity, not net portfolio P&L. Fluid is the tightest lending position with a 1.08 health rate.

insights.headline: $ARC is nearly flat; exit liquidity remains the larger signal
insights.summary: $ARC moved 0.3% over 24 hours at roughly $0.001561, while tracked DEX liquidity was approximately $15,155.
insights.portfolioRelevance: DeBank shows about $40,782 of directly held ARC before LP exposure, versus roughly $15,155 of tracked DEX liquidity. Gross NAV materially overstates realizable value.

risks.label: Fluid health rate

risks.trigger: Treat any further collateral decline or increase in debt as an immediate risk event.

risks.label: Safe Aave health rate
risks.detail: The cold-storage Safe has a 1.57 health rate with $3,596 of WETH supplied and $1,902 of USDC borrowed.
risks.trigger: Escalate if the health rate approaches 1.35 or withdrawals become constrained.

risks.label: $ARC exit liquidity
risks.detail: DeBank shows about $40,782 of directly held ARC before LP exposure, while tracked DEX liquidity is approximately $15,155.
risks.trigger: Treat self-token inventory as non-liquid unless an executable exit quote proves otherwise.
